translations.web: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
translations.bsb: Whoever kidnaps another man must be put to death, whether he sells him or the man is found in his possession.
translations.kjv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
translations.asv: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
